Cost depends on age and sex, which the rate CSV does not carry. Surrender charge + MVA also apply for 10 / up to 30 years.
Costs inside the account value are not disclosed and no payout-rate series exists.

Lifetime-guarantee base rate (no rate period), AV reduced by monthly insurance charges; first-insurance-period death benefit suppressed (2 or 5 years) so cash value is not a rate roll-up. Account value is not the premium rolled at the published rate: initial 契約時費用 is deducted for the declared plans and monthly 死亡・高度障害保障/契約維持費用 are deducted from 積立金 ('積立金が基準利率でそのまま複利運用されるものではありません'); the insurer states 実質的な利回り is below 基準利率. Cash value also depends on 基本保険金額 age/sex-priced guarantee. Does not fit accumulation model.

Whole-life contract with 積立利率 fixed for life (no reset); AV = (P - 契約初期費用) rolled at 積立利率, but monthly death (and 高度障害 for 告知あり) costs are deducted from AV so 積立利率 is not the effective yield; surrender within 20 years is multiplied by an MVA factor with a very long duration (remaining months to age 95 x 0.7, up to 360 months). Does not fit the accumulation model; no clean maturity concept.

予定利率 is not an effective yield: 3.80% of 基本保険金額 is deducted at issue (契約初期費用), and 保険契約関係費用 is deducted from 積立金 each year (age/sex dependent); the insurer states 'プレミアムや積立金が予定利率でそのまま複利運用されるものではありません' and that 実質的な利回り = annualised 10-year surrender value vs 基本保険金額. A 70-year-old male example grows about 3.26% a year vs 3.50% 予定利率. Fits accumulation only approximately.

Survival-weighted annuity with a payout phase: 基本年金額 depends on age, sex, rate and payout period and is not in the rate data; no accumulation maturity value; the CSV holds only crediting/base index/MVA reference rates. At best a rough payout proxy (premium x annuity-certain factor at the crediting rate over 2+20 years) understating the actual annuity.
